title: pvConvertToPointCloud
body:
## pvConvertToPointCloud

Converts any dataset into polydata that keeps only the input points and their point-data arrays; cells and cell data are dropped. CellGenerationMode decides whether the result has one vertex cell per point (ParaView default), a single polyvertex cell, or no cells at all. Use it to treat mesh nodes or particles as a point cloud, e.g. before pvPCANormalEstimation or point-based interpolation.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Cell-centred fields are lost; run cellToPoint first if they are needed on the points.
- With No cells, many filters and renderers see nothing to draw; keep vertex cells unless a later step needs cell-free points.
- On large image or structured inputs the explicit point list can need much more memory than the original grid.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ConvertToPointCloud`. Identity: `filters/ConvertToPointCloud`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input dataset to the ConvertToPointCloud filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellGenerationMode` | Choose if the output should contain either no cells (output may not appear in a render view in that case), a single poly vertex cell and as many vertex cells as there is points. | `{"type":"enum","values":["No cells","Polyvertex cell","Vertex cells"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"No cells"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvConvertToPointCloud",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
